title: Real Palace Blue — 2+1 apartment
description: Apartment for sale in the Real Palace Blue residential complex (premium class, 29 floors, New Boulevard, ~170 m from the sea). Total area — 81.7 m², living area — 61.7 m². Price — $140,000. Payment terms: down payment $70,000; no additional payments required until August 2026; remaining $70,000 from August until 15 February 2027. Real Palace Blue: panoramic sea, mountain and city views; parking, ground-floor retail; near Metro City and Lech and Maria Kaczyński Park.
